source_facts.correct: A currently active unrepaired instrument fault is repaired, correct reward is returned, and false count resets to zero.
source_facts.false: False count increments by one; settlement is zero up to the configured free allowance, otherwise false penalty.
source_facts.report_time: Reports have identical start/end, zero duration, and blank observe_index. Report itself does not alter the denominator N used by exposure-window invalidations.
source_facts.source_gap: Frozen Policy._repair rejects every earthquake notice and its clean low-E buffer excludes EarthquakeALL exposure feedback.
source_facts.identification: Low score fit loss does not independently identify instrument fault. Earthquake multiplies E, and C/E/program ambiguities remain.

stopping_mechanism.state: c remaining false-report coupons, b public posterior/state, R correct reward, G future score recovered by repair
stopping_mechanism.criterion: Report when report_value >= wait_value. No exposure-time term is charged, but false-coupon continuation value is a real opportunity cost.
stopping_mechanism.implemented: Heuristic stopping rule, not a fitted optimal posterior: median last 3-4 fresh informative E fits below .68, loss<.5, age<=7200s, cooldown>=86400s.

candidates.diagnostic-reserve: Use additional report while c>1; original unconfounded witness rule may use the reserved coupon.

stopping_mechanism.direct_nonnegative_proof: Additional branch enforces c>reserve>=0. If correct it receives configured reward; if false new count is <= allowance and settlement zero. No negative report settlement is possible through the added branch on the public cards.
stopping_mechanism.limitation: Neither zero direct report cost nor unchanged report-time N proves nonnegative total score. False diagnostics spend future coupons and reset source belief. Changes in future exposures may change data-loss windows.

experiment_scope.train: L1 compares consuming all free coupons against preserving one.
experiment_scope.validation: L2 checks the locked L1 choice.
experiment_scope.threshold: .68 from existing source before any diagnostic run; no threshold fitting to heldout cards.
experiment_scope.solver_features: Only ordinary initial public constants, score-only hit feedback, public geometry/program, notices, and report results.
